_meta.name: EDEAR Tier Breakpoints + Saturation Thresholds
_meta.purpose: Stage 4 floor-departure detection - the A-score thresholds that translate continuous engine output into customer-facing tier vocabulary. Frozen with the framework; same breakpoints across all classes.

engine_tier_breakpoints.comment: A <= 1.05 NORMAL; 1.05-1.07 MARGINAL; 1.07-1.10 DETECTABLE; > 1.10 FLOOR_BREACH. Below 1.0 is BELOW_NORMAL (suppression/homogenization).

warburg_threshold.comment: Approximate Warburg metabolic transition threshold - the energy/order regime where cells flip from oxidative to glycolytic metabolism. Open problem G-004 for exact derivation.

saturation_thresholds.comment: Per Appendix E §E.4/§E.6. Structural: if a (class, substrate) ceiling 1/H_min is below 1.10, the substrate is structurally blind for that class even at full departure. Runtime: if measured A is within 0.005 of the ceiling, further departure cannot be resolved.

customer_facing_vocabulary.comment: Customer-facing labels collapse engine tiers 3-5 into a single 'SIGNIFICANTLY_ELEVATED' bucket to keep the wellness-report vocabulary plain-English. The engine still computes all six tiers internally - the collapse is only at the report-rendering layer.
